en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Roman women (slaves). He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Buy them and sell them’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr from fbrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Hamid who has said the foiiowing:
“About the case of buying and the sale of Romans, abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘(If they are for sale), buy and sell them.’”
